user.title: Hot-water circulation
user.description: Select temperature sensors and the pump switch and set the runtime. New installations start in monitoring mode with automation disabled.

data_description.flow_sensor: Select the temperature sensor on the supply/circulation pipe. Only sensors with the temperature device class are shown.
data_description.buffer_sensor: Optional temperature sensor in the hot-water buffer. Leave empty if none is used.
data_description.pump_entity: Select the existing switch that controls the circulation pump. Selecting it does not switch the pump.
data_description.runtime_seconds: Runtime per start in seconds, from 1 to 3600. Default: 120 seconds.
data_description.max_starts: Daily limit for automatic starts, from 1 to 100. Default: 6.

calendar.title: Holiday calendar
calendar.description: Select a country for public holidays. Leave empty to keep the holiday row unconfigured while collecting weekdays.

data_description.country: Optional. Regional subdivisions can be selected in the next step.

region.title: State / region
region.description: Select a region to include regional holidays. Leave empty to use nationwide public holidays only.

data_description.subdivision: Optional. Available regions depend on the selected country.

error.unknown_entity: This entity does not exist. Select an existing entity.
error.invalid_temperature_sensor: Select a sensor with the temperature device class.
error.invalid_pump: Select a switch for the circulation pump.
error.same_sensor: Select a different buffer sensor or leave this field empty.
error.invalid_runtime: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_max_starts: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100 starts per day.
error.unsupported_country: No holiday calendar is available for this country.
error.invalid_subdivision: Select a region from the list or clear the selection.

init.title: Configure circulation
init.description: Change selected entities and operating limits. Saving reloads the integration with the new settings. Clear the optional buffer sensor selection to remove it.
